category.reason: The 龙耀路 station marker on the map directly displays the station name and Line 11 badge requested by the instruction.

instruction.en: Find Longyao Road (龙耀路) metro station on Line 11 on the map.
instruction.zh: 在地图上找到 11 号线龙耀路地铁站。

reference.patch: Revised the original English instruction to locate Longyao Road (龙耀路) metro station on Line 11 and added the corresponding Chinese instruction. The original description incorrectly placed the station marker inside a white rectangular box and described the Line 11 badge as a red circle; the final instruction omits those inaccurate visual details. Extended the ground-truth box's left boundary from 216 to 210 pixels and updated category.reason to identify the station name and Line 11 badge.
